_comment: id_prefix: forward-only project prefix for new register items, decided 2026-08-04. Existing items (T-1 through T-163) keep their original unprefixed form permanently -- this project's own 'IDs are never reused and never renumbered' rule treats the full id string as fixed once assigned. Only T-164 onward uses the new 'XOT<n>' shape (no hyphen). Motivated by a real cross-project collision found while syncing repoman upstream: a closure narrative in a different project's own register (seam-ui) was confused by xolu's own bare 'T-160'/'T-161' mentioned in prose, corrupting their id sequence. Sibling projects use their own prefixes for the same reason: xoluman='XMT', seam='SET'. scripts/register.py hardcodes this value directly (NEW_PREFIX) rather than reading this file -- matching this project's own existing style of hardcoded paths/values throughout its in-repo tooling, not the generic repoman config.py system. This file exists as a discoverable, documented anchor point, not a mechanism register.py actually reads.
